(2) An exterior shot shows a traditional Japanese house (kominka) with white walls, dark wooden trim, and a tiled roof. The setting is daytime with natural light. A glass sliding door serves as the entrance, and the surrounding environment includes a gray stone wall and green plants. (3) The camera pans across the interior of the restaurant, revealing high wooden ceilings and shelves stocked with rows of wine bottles. The dining area features white chairs and tables covered with red linens, creating a sophisticated and welcoming indoor atmosphere. (4) Close-up shots feature a variety of dishes. A wooden tray contains nine small ceramic bowls, each holding a different appetizer like omelets and greens. A woman with dark hair and a white top is shown tasting a creamy tofu-based dessert on a cracker, expressing satisfaction with a smile. (5) In a professional kitchen, a cook wearing blue gloves prepares fresh yellow pasta. The pasta is shown being boiled and then sautéed in a pan with bacon and vegetables. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the fresh texture of the ingredients. (6) The finished pasta is served in a blue-patterned ceramic bowl. The video transitions to a private dining room with a long table and a chalkboard wall. It ends with another group toast and a final graphic info screen with social media handles and a pink background.
